title: EventOccurrence
description: Immutable memory of an occurrence (RFC-014 §6.3). Created ONLY by the mark-occurred review action on a Core Event entity — never by providers, never on date passage. Events are the beliefs; observed/experienced events are the fact stream.

event_uuid.description: The Core Event entity this occurrence realizes (core_-prefixed)

occurred_at.description: Real-world ground truth supplied by review (timezone-aware ISO); providers never set it, date passage never sets it

snapshot.description: The event's belief fields at marking time (title, starts_at, ends_at, location, participants, organizer, status) — immutable memory of the schedule as believed
